main_text.p: tandem anno M. cccc. lxxvii, prudentum & bonorum studio, omnis Wester-goa & Ostergoa in fœdus decenne cum civitate Groninganâ consensit. Cujus Hæc summa: Id quod anno M. cccc. xxii, à totâ gente Frisicâ Groningæ initum fœdus fuit, ratum sit, salvo nupero fœdere Collumano: Groninganis non licet at hoc decennio ullam præterea Ostergoæ aut Westergoæ partem fœdere hujusmodi implicare, aut prætoriæ potestati suæ subjicere: Conventus quotannis agatur alternis vicibus Groningæ & Leoardiæ, ad quem quini ab utraque parte homines sapientes mittantur: hiis x undecimus adjiciatur, quem ex Ostergoâ aut Westergoâ quini Groningani eligent, cùm conventus agetur Leoardiæ: quini verò Transflavicani, ex oppido aut agro Groningano cùm conventus ille Groningæ habebitur. Horum arbitrii sit causas omnes publicas & privatas, quæ in controversiam venient, cognoscere, disceptare, definire: quicquid definiverint, ab omnibus ratum habeatur: intraque præfixum tempus executioni mandetur ab iis apud quos sedes tenet condemnatus, aut ab ipsis illis multa peta-tur:

page.notes: The running head and the page number are printed in a slightly different type from the body; I have read the final letter of "Groningâ" in the running head as â, which is not fully clear. "xxii," in the date is read from a worn numeral and may be "xxi i" or "xxii". The "s" after "xxii" may be a stray mark. The final line "tur:" is set right-indented after a printed hyphen, so it is kept as "peta-tur:". The paragraph runs on to the next page.
